title: the founding *decision record*
dek: The candid evidence, qualification, message directions, release boundary, and first market test behind the V1 client room.
lens: customer truth · problem qualification · message-market fit
sources: canonical offer record · proof counters · operator decision

sections.heading: the internal verdict
sections.body:
The V1 client-delivery shape is coherent: the private room owns evidence and disagreement; the client room owns decision clarity. The Angle Map should lead with the upstream decision a team must settle before funding more creative, not with AI-generated variety or a compliance promise.

This remains a founding hypothesis. The available record proves a bounded offer and delivery mechanism, not a recurring customer problem, willingness to pay, or message-market fit.

rows.claim: S02 · FACT — the offer is bounded
rows.evidence: $750 prepaid; one live message read; three campaign angles; approved-proof direction; claim-safety boundary; one lead recommendation; delivery within 48 hours after readiness and payment.

rows.claim: S04 · FACT — no market event has occurred
rows.evidence: The current decision record shows zero qualified exposures, held conversations, sales, and collections. Prepared strategy is not demand proof.

rows.claim: S01 · CLAIM — the client-delivery system should feel premium and repeatable
rows.evidence: The operator approved the dual-edition workflow, hybrid intake, and decision-room handoff as the V1 direction.

rows.claim: I01 · INFERENCE — decision-before-creative is the strongest lead
rows.evidence: It expresses the offer's upstream job and distinguishes the service from option generation, but it has not been confirmed in customer language.

rows.claim: U01 · UNKNOWN — buyers experience this problem urgently enough to pay
rows.evidence: No direct customer action, interview, purchase, or qualified exposure currently ties the problem to the proposed segment.

sections.heading: problem-qualified segment — provisional
sections.kicker: PUBLIC TRACES ARE NOT CUSTOMER TRUTH
sections.dek: The operating target is precise enough for discovery, not qualified enough for a demand claim.

items.why: Established supplement, functional-nutrition, recovery, or performance brands with one live market occasion inside 90 days.
Several plausible message directions, usable evidence and claim boundaries, one decision deadline, and authority to spend $750.
Founder, CEO, brand lead, or marketing owner responsible for choosing the campaign argument and able to bring the final decision-maker.
The team funds more creative before settling which buyer belief and approved proof should organize the campaign.
A pre-revenue founder still deciding what to sell may want messaging help but does not fit this decision product.

items.action: 1 · Decide before you fund more creative
items.why: Buyer belief: the expensive mistake is not weak execution; it is building execution around an unresolved campaign argument. Proof direction: live occasion, competing directions, current evidence, decision deadline.

items.action: 2 · Make the proof choose the message
items.why: Buyer belief: approved evidence and claim boundaries should shape the campaign direction before copy expands. Risk: cannot imply legal or regulatory sign-off.

items.action: 3 · Settle the campaign argument in 48 hours
items.why: Buyer belief: the team can compress the decision without compressing judgment. Risk: speed is a delivery feature, not evidence that the strategy will perform.

blocks.label: FROZEN HYPOTHESIS
blocks.text: Established performance brands facing one live campaign decision will recognize 'decide before you fund more creative' as a consequential problem and request a one-page decision note.

blocks.label: BATCH
blocks.text: Five qualified exposures. Keep the segment, problem, proof object, and message shell fixed. Follow up once only when separately authorized.

blocks.label: COUNTERS
blocks.text: Qualified exposure · meaningful response · direct problem confirmation · decision-note request · held conversation · unchanged $750 acceptance · money collected.

blocks.label: THRESHOLDS
blocks.text: Promote: 2 of 5 meaningful responses plus 1 direct problem confirmation. Commercial proof begins only with one unchanged offer acceptance and cleared payment. Kill the segment/problem hypothesis after 10 qualified exposures plus permitted follow-up produce zero problem confirmations.

sections.heading: unknowns and release boundary
sections.kicker: DO NOT PROMOTE READINESS INTO PROOF
sections.body: The PQS is PROVISIONAL because the current record lacks two independent evidence methods and case-level customer evidence tying action or language to the problem and segment. The three angles are strategic candidates, not winners. No outreach, publishing, client transfer, or third-party reuse is authorized by this room. Real confidential intake remains blocked until the transfer channel, storage, access, NDA, retention, deletion, and AI-permission fields contain tested literal values.
